title: Avatar
description: A person on the Squircle tile in three faces, each the fallback of the last: the photograph clipped to the curve and covering it, the initials over the glass, and a person icon when there is not even a name. A photograph that fails to load falls back too. Decorative by default; the name beside it carries the meaning.

anatomy.description: The Squircle root with data-slot="avatar" and data-face="image" | "initials" | "icon" naming the face that shows; props are src, name, and the Squircle's size and colours.
An SVG <image> covering the tile (xMidYMid slice), clipped to the curve by the Squircle; its load error switches the face to initials.
First and last initial (one letter for a single word) centred over the glass; the module owns their colour and weight.
The heroicons person outline, centred at 56% of the tile, the last resort when there is no name.

usage: Pass src for the photograph and name for the initials; leave both out for the icon. The face is picked from the data and published as data-face, so CSS can specialise on it.

Keep it decorative (aria-hidden by default); put the person's name in the text beside it (component-architecture §5.4). Override aria-hidden with role="img" and aria-label only when nothing beside it names the person.
Size the rendered box from CSS (width and height on the svg); size sets the tile's coordinate space, and the initials and icon scale with it.
Draw people with Avatar and tiles with Squircle: the tenant switcher's Blobatar sits on a bare Squircle, and a third face belongs here, not in a consumer.
